subject: Decision criteria & procurement gaps — pilot scope and champion enablement
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samir Rao <samir.rao@silverleafbank.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-05-19T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Decision criteria & procurement gaps — pilot scope and champion enablement

Hi Samir — thanks again for the time earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum with your champion and the procurement lane.

Call summary (what we heard)
- Champion / day-to-day owner: you (Head of ML) — will own technical validation and frontline cost/latency checks.
- Economic buyer: CTO (A note from you: finance will be involved for pilot funding sign-off).
- Key non-negotiables:
  - Data residency: US-only (primary in us-east),
  - Compliance: SOC 2 Type II and encryption at-rest + in-transit,
  - Latency: interactive flows target ~<200ms median token latency,
  - Pricing guardrails for pilot: must be predictable and capped.
- Procurement timeline: internal procurement + legal expect vendor questionnaire and pricing within 2–3 weeks to get on next vendor review cycle.

Gaps we should close this week
1) Procurement asks — we need the vendor questionnaire + a short compliance pack (SOC2 evidence pointer).
2) Decision criteria doc — a 1-page mapping that calls out who signs and what metric/evidence they want (latency, TCO, security).
3) Champion enablement pack — a short playbook with exec talk tracks (CTO/Finance), an ROI snippet for pilot, and a mutual action plan (MAP) with milestones.

Proposed next steps
- I will send a draft MAP and ROI one-pager to arm you for the exec conversation (Ben will add pricing scenarios).
- Karthik will prepare a tailored security Q&A and pointer to SOC2 artifacts.
- Samir — can you confirm procurement contact (name + email) and the earliest vendor-review date? Also flag if legal requires an SLA clause for data retention.

Attaching: none in this message — will follow with MAP and ROI.

Thanks — Olg a
Olga Petrov
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com
+1 415-555-0182

From: Samir Rao <samir.rao@silverleafbank.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-05-19T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Decision criteria & procurement gaps — pilot scope and champion enablement

Olga — thanks for the clear recap. A few clarifications from my side:
- Procurement and legal: please include Mark Duncan (VP, Procurement) <mark.duncan@silverleafbank.com> and Aisha Kapoor (CISO) <aisha.kapoor@silverleafbank.com> on any compliance artifacts. They want a short answers doc + links to SOC2/TLS certs.
- Pilot constraints: budget is pre-approved for a two-month pilot at constrained scope, but procurement wants a fixed not-to-exceed number. Please provide a capped quote and a simple success definition (e.g., 95th perc. latency under X and qualitative accuracy baseline).
- Timeline: vendor review meeting on 2027-06-02 is likely; if we have MAP + pricing + SOC2 references by 2027-05-24 I can get us into the packet.

I'll be the internal champion but will need a tight one-pager that I can forward to CTO/Procurement with suggested language for exec sponsorship.

—Samir
Samir Rao
Head of ML, Silverleaf Bank
samir.rao@silverleafbank.com

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-05-20T10:25:00-07:00
Subject: Silverleaf MAP + pilot ROI (draft)

Putting the draft materials in one place — attached:
- Silverleaf-MAP-v1.xlsx (mutual action plan with milestones + owners) [Attachment: Silverleaf-MAP-v1.xlsx]
- pilot-ROI-onepager.pdf (short financial argument and example cost math) [Attachment: pilot-ROI-onepager.pdf]
- SLB-pilot-pricing-quote.pdf (two pricing scenarios: bounded pilot & expanded pilot) [Attachment: SLB-pilot-pricing-quote.pdf]

Champion enablement / talk tracks (short)
- CTO / Finance (economic lens): "We can run a scoped pilot with predictable capped costs and measurable throughput improvements. We will measure TCO delta vs current inference path and project 6–12 month payback on productionized use."
- CISO / Legal (risk lens): "Redwood provides SOC 2 artifacts, customer-controlled KMS options, and can support a VPC/private deployment path if required."
- For Samir (champion): two-sentence email you can forward to your CTO: we recommend the line below.

Suggested forwardable blurb for Samir:
"We propose a two-month pilot with Redwood Inference to validate production latency and cost. Redwood will provide a mutual action plan, SOC2 evidence pointers, and a fixed-price pilot option to limit financial exposure. If the pilot meets latency and accuracy gates, we will evaluate scale-up with a dedicated reserved pool."

Ask for internal alignment:
- Olga: please review the MAP timeline and confirm milestones.
- Karthik: can you review the pilot pricing for any obvious gaps vs. security/operation asks?

Ben
Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-05-20T13:40:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Silverleaf MAP + pilot ROI (draft)

Quick security take — attaching a targeted pack that addresses the procurement checklist items from our call. [Attachment: SOC2-evidence-request.pdf]

Key asks from Silverleaf's security/infosec we should pre-answer:
- Which SOC2 controls map to inference runtime (provide control IDs and short explanations).
- Data flow diagram (showing no PHI transfer to third parties, KMS usage, and retention windows).
- SLA / data retention clause options (ops can sign post pilot-level retention policy).

Recommendation:
- I will draft a 1-page security Q&A (controls + short example artifacts) by EOD 2027-05-21.
- Ops: include the minimal privacy/data-retention clause for the pilot in the MAP so procurement can see it up front.

Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Security & Privacy Lead | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com
